senses.gloss:
निद् 1. निद्, cl. 1. P. A. नेदति, नेदते,
निनेद, निनिदे or निनेदे, नेदिता, &c.,
to be near [cf. rt. नेद्, नेदीयस्, नेदिष्ठ]; to
ridicule, blame, reproach, censure, &c., (in this sense
properly a separate rt., the form of which is usually
निन्द्, q. v.): Desid., Ved. निनित्सति, to wish to
reproach or depreciate; [cf. rt. निन्द्; Gr. ὄ-νειδ-
ο-ς, probably λοίδ-ο-ρο-ς; Goth. ga-nait-yan, nai-
teins, probably neith; Old Germ. neiz-yan; Angl.
Sax. naet-an, naet-ing, nidh, ge-nidhe, ‘hatred;’
Mod. Germ. neid, ‘envy.’]

2. निद्, त्, f., Ved. mocking, ridiculing, despising,
censure, contempt; (त्), m. one who ridicules or con-
temns, a blamer, an enemy.
1. निदा, f., Ved. blame, contempt.

निदा 2. नि-दा (rt. 1. दा), cl. 3. P. -ददाति,
&c., Ved. to give. (For 1. निदा see above.)

निदा 3. नि-दा (rt. 4. दा, to bind), cl. 4. P.
-द्यति, &c., Ved. to fasten.

निद नि-द, अम्, n. (said to be fr. नि-दो),
poison, venom.

1. निदान, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. (= निद्यमान),
reproached, ridiculed. (For 2. see 3. नि-दा, col. 3.)

2. नि-दान, अम्, n. (for 1. निदान see col. 2),
a band, a rope, a halter; a rope for tying up a calf
&c.; a first or original cause, a primary or remote
cause [cf. नि-बन्धन]; original form, essence,
(निदानेन, ind. originally, essentially, properly);
the cause of a disease, inquiry into the causes of
disease, pathology, i. e. study of the symptoms with
a view to trace the remote or proximate causes, (re-
garded as a department of medical science; the six-
teen Nidānas being the title of the sixteen divisions
into which it is divided; cf. निदान-स्थान); N.
of a work on metres and Vedic Stomas (see निदान-
सूत्र); end, termination, cessation; purification,
purity, correctness; claiming the reward of peni-
tential acts.
—निदान-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. founded
on a cause, essential.
—निदान-सूत्र, अम्, n. a work
in ten Prapāṭhakas on metres and Vedic Stomas.
—निदान-स्थान, अम्, n. one of the five depart-
ments of medical science, inquiry into the causes of
diseases, pathology.
निद्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being reproached, &c.

निदण्ड नि-दण्ड, अस्, m., according to a
commentator = निहित-दण्ड, a stick put aside or laid
down; (अस्, आ, अम्), one who has put down a stick
(i. e. not using force), one who has laid down a staff.
निदत्त नि-दत्त. See 2. नि-दा below.

नि-दत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, given, given absolutely; [cf.
नीत्त.]

निदद्रु निद-द्रु, उस्, m. (said to be fr. निद
+ द्रु), a man.
निदर्शन नि-दर्शन. See नि-दृश्, col. 3.

नि-दर्शन, अस्, ई, अम्, pointing to, showing,
foreshowing, prognosticating, indicating; proclaim-
ing, announcing, teaching; suiting, pleasing?; (आ),
f. a simile, a comparison; (अम्), n. seeing, look-
ing into, view, insight, sight, vision (e. g. स्वप्न-
निदर्शन, a vision in sleep); pointing to; showing;
evidence; an example or illustration; a designation
[]
of the third member of a complete syllogism (usually
called उद्-आहरण, q. v.); a foreboding, prognostic,
sign, mark, omen; a scheme, system; injunction, pre-
cept, ordinance, scriptural authority; authority, text.

निदह् नि-दह्, cl. 1. P. -दहति, -दग्धुम्,
to burn down, consume by fire.

नि-दाघ, अस्, m. (according to native lexicogra-
phers also अम्, n.), heat, warmth; the hot season
(May and June), summer; internal heat, sweat,
perspiration; N. of a man; N. of a son of Pulastya;
(आस्), m. pl. the descendants of the former person.
—निदाघ-कर, अस्, m. ‘heat causer’ or ‘hot-
rayed,’ the sun.
—निदाघ-काल, अस्, m. ‘the time
of heat,’ the hot season, two months previous to the
rains, about May and June.
—निदाघ-सिन्धु, उस्,
m. a river in hot weather, one nearly dry.
निदाघ नि-दाघ. See नि-दह्, col. 2.

नि-दातृ, ता, त्री, तृ, Ved. one who fastens or ties
up; (Sāy.) a restrainer, obstructer, (as if fr. rt. 3. दा.)

निदिग्धिका, f. = कण्ट-कारिका, a species of prickly
nightshade, Solanum Jacquini [cf. निर्-दिग्धिका, निर्-
दग्धिका]; cardamoms.

निदिध्यासन नि-दिध्यासन, अम्, n. (fr. the
Desid. of rt. ध्यै), profound and repeated medi-
tation.

नि-दिध्यासन, अम्, n. profound meditation,
deep and repeated consideration, thinking of or re-
calling repeatedly.
नि-दिध्यासु, उस्, उस्, उ, desiring to meditate upon.
नि-दिध्यासु, उस्, उस्, उ, desirous of meditating on.

नि-दिध्येय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be deeply meditated
upon.

निदिश् नि-दिश्, cl. 6. P. -दिशति, -देष्टुम्,
to order, point out, &c.; (perhaps for निर्-दिश् and
apparently only used in the derivatives below.)

नि-दिष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, ordered, directed; advised,
enjoined; explained, pointed out.

नि-देश, अस्, m. order, command, direction, in-
struction; speech, speaking, narration, conversation;
vicinity, proximity, neighbourhood; = भाजन, a
vessel, vase; (ए), ind. in the vicinity, near.
—निदेश-
कारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, executing orders, obedient, servile.
निदेश नि-देश. See नि-दिश्, p. 486, col. 3.

नि-देशिन्, ई, इनी, इ, showing, directing, ordering,
pointing out; (इनी), f. a region, quarter, point of
the compass.
नि-देश्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be ordered, to be told.

नि-देष्टृ, टा, ट्री, टृ, who or what points out
or orders; explaining, advising, commanding.

निदी नि-दी, cl. 3. P. (see rt. 2. दी), Ved.
to shine down upon; (Sāy. = नितराम् प्र-काश्, to
shine exceedingly.)
निदुश निदुश, अस्, m. a fish.

निदृश् नि-दृश्, Caus. -दर्शयति, -यितुम्,
to cause to see, to show, point, to point out; to
introduce, cause to enter; to impart knowledge,
communicate, teach; advise; to appear (in a vision)
to any person (acc.).

नि-दर्शक, अस्, आ, अम्, seeing into, perceiving;
seeing; pointing out, proclaiming, announcing.
नि-दर्शित, अस्, आ, अम्, illustrated, exemplified.

नि-दर्शिन्, ई, इनी, इ, seeing, viewing, having an
insight into, familiar with, knowing.

निद्रा 1. नि-द्रा or नि-द्रै, cl. 1. 2. P. A.
-द्रायति, -ते, -द्राति, &c., to fall asleep, sleep.

2. नि-द्रा, f. (said to be fr. rt. निन्द् + affix र),
sleep, slumber, sleepiness, sloth; (in flowers the
budding state is considered as sleep. hence निद्रां
त्यज् = to bloom); a mystical N. of the letter भ्.
—निद्रा-दरिद्र, अस्, m., N. of a poet.
—निद्रान्-
ध (˚रा-अन्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, blind with sleep.
—नि-
द्रा-भङ्ग, अस्, m. rousing from sleep, awaking;
[cf. भग्न-निद्र.]
—निद्रा-मय, अस्, ई, अम्,
consisting in sleep.
—निद्रा-योग, अस्, m. sleep
and deep meditation; [cf. योग-निद्रा.]
—निद्रा-
लस (˚रा-अल्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, slothful from drowsi-
ness, fast asleep, sleepy.
—निद्रा-वृक्ष, अस्, m.
darkness.
—निद्रा-सञ्जनन, अम्, n. ‘producing
drowsiness,’ phlegm, the phlegmatic humor.

नि-द्राण, अस्, आ, अम्, sleeping, asleep, sleepy,
drowsy; shut up, closed (as a bud or blossom).
नि-द्रात्, आन्, आती or आन्ती, आत्, sleeping.
नि-द्रायमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, sleeping, asleep.

नि-द्रालु, उस्, उस्, उ, sleeping, sleepy, drowsy,
slothful; (उस्), m. an epithet of Viṣṇu; (उस्), f. the
plant Solanum Melongena; another plant (= वन-
वर्वरिका); a kind of perfume (= नली).
—नि-
द्रालु-त्व, अम्, n. sleepiness, drowsiness.

निद्रित, अस्, आ, अम्, sleeping, asleep.
—निद्रित-
वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having slept.

नि-दिध्यासितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be reflected or
meditated upon.
